name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening, let's get to it. South Carolina State put up 87 points on Savannah State in the season opener, a school record.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well Renee, you gotta give the Bulldogs credit, that's a big-time score right out of the gate. But let's see how they look when they face Florida A&M next week, that'll be a real test.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, forget the next week for a sec...87-0 ain’t just a score, it’s a statement. Largest FCS win since 2025’s Idaho State blowout. That margin? Unmatched history.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Cassius, an 87-point win is impressive, no doubt. But that Florida A&M game is the real barometer for whether they can hang with the big dogs.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, they ain’t just talking at the top, they’re ranked No. 24 in FCS with that record-setting 87 points. That's not hype, that’s facts putting the crown on their head right now.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, a ranking is a snapshot, not a resume. Savannah State's record going in, is that the measure you want the crown standing on?

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee's got a point, folks. You gotta show it against top-tier competition to truly earn that crown.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, credibility lives in the scoreboard and the record books. Largest FCS win since that 90-0 blowout in 2025 ain't a maybe, it’s a fact. That kind of dominance doesn't pause for 'top-tier' chatter.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Gosh, Cassius, that's a stat I didn't have! But one historic win doesn't make a season, does it?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, let’s get real, last season’s Celebration Bowl champ don’t show up to flex...they show up to dominate. This 87-point opener? That’s more than a flash, that’s legacy in motion.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Andrew, if the Bulldogs roll into that road test and win big, does the crown talk end right there, or do you find another hurdle?

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Here's what nobody's said plainly: Coach Berry isn't chasing a score, she's answering a question about last year's title.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee, Chennis Berry wants to prove that title wasn't a fluke, and that means beating FAMU.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: So that's the through-line, folks. The 87 points are the headline, but FAMU is the story that actually settles this.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Pull up, the scoreboard's loud but the message is louder: South Carolina State’s 87-0 ain’t just a win, it’s a blueprint for the season. FAMU’s a test, but the real story?

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, you can call it a blueprint, but nobody's tested it yet. Florida A&M answers that next week, not tonight.
